outcome: Differentially expressed proteins in placental tissues
cohort: The study included pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus as the experimental group and pregnant women with normal glucose metabolism as the control group.
finding: The study identified 91 differential proteins in placental tissues of GDM patients compared to controls (32 up-regulated and 59 down-regulated), which are mainly involved in processes like protein binding, neutrophil degranulation, and pathways such as HIF-1 signaling and Glycolysis/Gluconeogenesis.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth (placental tissue collection)
